name: P12 talk framing — gudgeon pond is not a black void

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const skip=async()=>{for(let k=0;k<14;k++){try{__DQ.press('confirm');}catch(_){}await sleep(80);}await sleep(200);};for(const id of ['pell','hen1','tansy','sausage']){try{await __DQ.talkTo(id);}catch(e){}await sleep(400);await skip();}const gudgeon=(__DQ.npcs()||[]).find(n=>n.id==='gudgeon');if(gudgeon)__DQ.walkTo(gudgeon.x+1.2,gudgeon.z+0.4);await sleep(1600);try{await __DQ.talkTo('gudgeon');}catch(e){}await sleep(1100);for(let i=0;i<60;i++)__DQ.advance(16.6667);const shot=__DQ.talkShot();const canvas=document.querySelector('canvas');let lum=null;if(canvas){const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=160;c.height=90;const g=c.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});g.drawImage(canvas,0,0,160,90);const d=g.getImageData(0,0,160,54);let s=0,dark=0,n=d.data.length/4;for(let i=0;i<d.data.length;i+=4){const Y=0.2126*d.data[i]+0.7152*d.data[i+1]+0.0722*d.data[i+2];s+=Y;if(Y<55)dark++;}lum={mean:+(s/n).toFixed(1),darkFrac:+(dark/n).toFixed(3),n};}window.__G={shot,lum,framed:shot&&shot.framed};return JSON.stringify(window.__G);})()
